company.name: Poll Everywhere
company.shortDescription: Poll Everywhere is a web, SMS, and Twitter polling service that allows users to submit votes or comments to a PowerPoint or Keynote slide.
company.description:
Poll Everywhere is a hybrid work solution that enables audience engagement through live, inclusive conversations. 

It's the largest presentation polling tool. Audiences participate directly in presentations, with polls and ideas visible live in PowerPoint, Keynote, or Google Slides.

In 2008 Poll Everywhere participated in Y Combinator.
